verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a terminal AI agent that debugs C/C++ code. It joins a live gdb session through a bridge and reads the program state, drives sanitizers such as AddressSanitizer (usable even in read-only runs), and returns raw reports with frames, files and line numbers so the developer can check the agent's reasoning. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), and explicit documentation of the natural-language query workflow itself, which is only implied by the conversational agent/TUI framing.
